title: MAT-9 — portable repo profile + work-item adapter
description: Human- and machine-readable profile for a single repo: identity, repo-relative paths, and a discriminated work-item source. No org-specific URLs are required; optional base URLs exist only for self-hosted providers.
notes: YAML documents MUST parse to the same JSON object shape validated by repo-profile.schema.json.
Orchestrators resolve repo_root out-of-band (absolute path); this profile never embeds another machine's filesystem paths.
